candidate.definition_en: To make someone extremely annoyed or angry; to drive insane.
candidate.explanation_ar: يعصب حد جداً ويطير عقله، أو يجننه.

senses.definition_en: To make someone extremely annoyed or angry; to drive insane.
senses.definition_ar: أن يُغضب شخصاً بشدة أو يثير حنقه وجنونه.

examples: To be ignored completely is enough to madden anyone.
Such persistent delays would madden even the most patient traveler.
It was an evasive tactic designed to madden his opponents.
candidate.mnemonic: جاية من 'Mad' 'مجنون'.. الـ 'Madden' هو الفعل، يعني يجنن حد.
